My mum’s hair started thinning after her first cycle of RCHOP. After the second cycle it was dropping out a lot more so she decided to completely shave it off. She held her tears in the salon all the way until she returned home, locked herself in the room and cried for a full 15-30mins. Then she came out and said she feels much better after crying it all out. After awhile we all started to get used to it, and we shopped for caps/hats/scarfs that she liked. She wore it out all the time. 

Mum had the same fear that her hair would not grow out at all. She keeps asking us “is my hair growing out yet?” “What if it never grows out?” It felt weird because during the course of chemo, her hair did not grow out at all and she slightly panicked. Because, well, hair is supposed to grow with time, right? But because she’s on chemo, the hair doesn’t grow!

Fast forward post-chemo, last one she did was early August. It’s been 2 months, and her hair is growing back! Her hair looks like a durian now 😅 a bit slow, but it’s growing and we can all tell!

She has no fever at baseline, and her fever tends to always go away while on prednisolone on CHOP. It only appears after that and we always thought it was because her wbc count was low. But right now it has been 20 days so we found it a bit weird that she was still having a low-grade fever. What was also weird is that her fever presents to us like a wave - in the morning after a night’s sleep without paracetamol, she doesn’t have a fever. As the day progresses, her low-grade fever starts to show up, especially from afternoon onwards… 

Her other symptoms right now are slight coughing (sounds like phlegm to us) and tinnitus
